summary: Rectangular green stepper-driver breakout PCB (0.9 in x 2.05 in) with a 0.1 in pitch through-hole pin pattern along both long edges and at the short ends. It carries a surface-mount driver IC, an electrolytic capacitor and a trimmer potentiometer on the top face. The bottom face is flat apart from a ground pad and a small vented pad grid. The bounding box is the bare board, centered on the origin.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat bottom face of the PCB. It has a small exposed pad grid and a ground pad, and sits on the pin headers or solder joints.
Top face of the PCB, carrying the driver IC, electrolytic capacitor, trimmer potentiometer and small SMD parts. Not a flat seating surface.

notes: Only the outer dimensions are stated: 0.9 in x 2.05 in, which is 22.86 x 52.07 mm. The 1.6 mm thickness, the roughly 1.0 mm hole diameter and the exact pin count and positions are assumptions. The 2.54 mm pitch and the side rows at x = ±10.16 mm are inferred from the 0.1 in grid and the board width. The listed holes cover only the two long-edge rows. The images also show holes along the top end (power and motor outputs) and a row near the bottom end (VREF, AGC_ON, AWGS, AGC_AUTO, ADMD, DECAY2, DECAY1), but these positions are not given and are not listed. Component height above the board (capacitor and IC) is not stated and is excluded from the z bound.
